correctness.rationale: Reduction modulo X^4+1 exactly detects all Fourier zeros. In the resulting character-difference graph, |A|-cliques are exactly the unordered orthogonal bases. Tiling is the exact cover by translates labeled by their translating element; labels must remain distinct even when two translates are identical as sets. The affine group has 16 translations and 16 automorphisms: the images of the two generators are (a,b) with a odd and (c,1) with c in {0,4}. An independent complete 65,535-subset run counted cliques and labeled exact covers, not the submitted subset-zeta transform. It matched all displayed marginals and zero strata, all 43 orbit sizes and per-member multiplicities, and both size-four off-diagonal joint counts (16,32):32 and (32,16):112.
residual_risks: This confirms the single finite group, not an extension to larger groups.

value.rationale: This natural small noncyclic group tests a quantitative question left open by the qualitative Fuglede equivalence. The complete affine-type table gives reusable examples and distinguishes, in both directions, the counts of spectra and complements at the same set size.
